name: Oaxaca
oneLineFragment: Agave fields & copal smoke in the Sierra Madre foothills.
narrativeStory:
The blue spikes of espadín and tobalá puncture the red clay slopes of the Central Valleys. Smoke from earthen pit ovens curls toward the Sierra Madre crests like ancient offering smoke.

In small palenques, donkey-driven tahona stones crush roasted hearts into fermenting fibers. Life here moves to the rhythm of season rains and woodsmoke.
subtitle: Sierra Madre del Sur • Valles Centrales
introLines: Clay dust raised by pack mules on mountain ridges.
Sweet fragrance of caramelized agave hearts cooling under palm mats.
Six medium-format rolls preserved from the dry season.
